program.name: Complex Ladder Plus
program.subject: Kettlebell complexes
program.blurb: Two kettlebell complex ladders, then a core circuit.
program.about: Climb twice, then brace. Each day is two ladders of two complex moves, one rep of each, then two, then three, as high as you can go, then a short core circuit with the bell. Two days alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III slows every rep down.
program.split: Two complex ladders and a core circuit, A / B
